cards.card_text: The LORD answers, "Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon." Abram asks ONE question and gets back a whole LIST, ages included!
cards.verse_text: And the LORD said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
cards.snippet: …a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
